Our team consists of curious students with a shared interest in technology, agriculture, and innovation. We combine our strengths in programming, electronics, research, and problem-solving to develop practical solutions to real-world challenges. Through FarmView, we aim to explore the intersection of technology and agriculture, using innovation to address challenges faced by farmers. Our goal is to create a solution that is accessible and impactful.
